lines.blood-cry: I am the toast at every wake. Drink, and drive into my arms.
lines.blood-taunt1: One more for the road... your last.
lines.blood-taunt2: Point oh eight. That is all it takes.
lines.blood-defeat: I was the toast at every wake. You silenced me with one number.
lines.ember-cry: Your eyes belong to the screen now. Look away if you dare.
lines.ember-taunt0: Glance at me. Just for a second.
lines.ember-taunt2: Eyes off the road, little driver.
lines.ember-defeat: They thought I was harmless because I was legal. You showed them the difference.
lines.static-cry: I live in the blind spot. The child you never saw.
lines.static-taunt1: Twenty miles an hour, and still too fast.
lines.static-defeat: I lived inside every ping. You looked away. That was all it took.
lines.iron-cry: Every sign is a riddle. Read wrong, and bleed.
lines.iron-taunt1: Red means stop. You did not.
lines.iron-defeat: My signs were warnings. You finally listened.
lines.thorn-cry: Six roads cross here, and every one is mine to grant.
lines.thorn-taunt0: You took what was not yours.
lines.thorn-defeat: Every intersection was my altar. You walked through unbloodied.
lines.bone-cry: I keep the final ledger. Every error written in bone.
lines.bone-defeat: Every number in my ledger was a debt. You paid them all.
